# EOLOS DESIGN LAB · International Desk (eoloslab.com)

> EOLOS DESIGN LAB is a design studio with three local studios (Madrid, Stockholm, Athens)
> and an International Desk that serves clients anywhere in the world. The desk offers a
> curated set of services: brand identity and strategy, web design and build, creative
> direction, and visualization by application. A senior partner leads every project, with
> no account layer. Full local production stays with the studio that owns each market.
> Part of the WOLFBLANC group.

## Services
- Brand Identity & Strategy: https://eoloslab.com/services/brand-identity.html
- Web Design & Build: https://eoloslab.com/services/web-design.html
- Creative Direction: https://eoloslab.com/services/creative-direction.html
- Visualization: https://eoloslab.com/services/visualization.html
- Services overview: https://eoloslab.com/services/
